summary: A hybrid embedding of Montague's PTQ (1973): deep syntax as category-annotated analysis trees (constructors for S2-S17 including quantifying-in F_10,n, relative clauses, tense/negation) with a shallow HOAS semantics realizing IL types directly as Coq types (e~Entity, t~Prop, s-types as Index->A over World*Time points of reference). The full intensional type assignment is kept where it matters — IV/CN denotations take individual concepts, T denotations are generalized quantifiers over concept-properties — with the lexicon as 38 abstract Parameters and Montague's p. 28 meaning postulates as 11 Axioms (rigid names, extensionality of ordinary IVs/CNs, seek = try-to-find, temporal ordering). A mutual Fixpoint interprets trees under assignment functions for he_n; interpreter-correctness theorems reproduce PTQ's translations for 'Bill walks', 'a man walks', 'every man walks'; de re/de dicto pairs for 'John finds/seeks a unicorn' are built as distinct trees (S14 vs S4+S5). The temperature-puzzle non-entailment is stated but Admitted, and as stated (negated universal over abstract Parameters) it is refutable in trivial instantiations, so it needs restating over a concrete model; the seek-ambiguity theorem is vacuous (right disjunct True). S6/S9/S13, the 'be' postulate and postulate (4) for extensional TVs are declared or commented but not interpreted (uninterpreted constructors silently denote True).

evidence: Interpreter-correctness theorems reproduce PTQ's own translations for 'Bill walks', 'a man walks', 'every man walks' with quantification over individual concepts exactly as in T2 (bill_walks_correct, a_man_walks_correct, every_man_walks_correct).

The full intensional type assignment is preserved where it is load-bearing: CN/IV denotations take individual concepts, so temperature'/price'/rise'/change' can hold of non-rigid concepts — the structural precondition of the temperature puzzle.
De re/de dicto pairs for 'John finds/seeks a unicorn' and Montague's p. 21 tree 'every man loves a woman such that she loves him' are constructed as distinct analysis trees per S14 vs S4+S5.

The headline claims are NOT established: temperature_puzzle is Admitted (and misformulated over abstract Parameters — refutable in trivial instantiations), and seek_ambiguity is a vacuous disjunction with True.

E_S6 and E_S9 constructors have no interpretation clause and silently denote True; postulate (4) and the 'be' postulate exist only as comments — so parts of T1-T17 the summary block claims are covered are in fact fallback stubs.
The 11 Axioms are (subsets of) Montague's own p. 28 meaning postulates plus the ordering of J, i.e. rubric 3(b)-admissible source axioms, each with a comment reference.
simplifications: shallow HOAS embedding of IL: no object-level IL syntax, ^ and v are meta-operations, t is Prop
s-layer on functor arguments partially absorbed into Prop_s results in the category-to-type map (kept for TV objects)
temporal ordering axiomatized as preorder only (Montague requires a simple ordering); time_lt not linked to time_le
meaning postulates restricted to a lexical subset; S17 tenses hard-coded as five constructors
omissions: S8/S13, term disjunction, 'be'/identity postulate, semantics for in'/about'/necessarily'/assert_that'
postulate (4) for extensional TVs, hence no proved de dicto = de re collapse for 'find'
'John wishes to find a unicorn and eat it' cross-VP binding (listed as future work)

determination_rationale: Provisional. Everything mechanized went through with only documented, prediction-preserving simplifications: the shallow s-layer absorption, HOAS for IL's lambda, and quantification over Coq's full function space Index->Entity; the 11 propositional axioms are Montague's own meaning postulates and the ordering of J (rubric 3b). Nothing in the file diagnoses a foundational resistance — the intensional type discipline that PTQ is famous for embeds directly. But this pilot does not certify determination 1-2 on its own terms: faithfulness is only partial because the two headline intensionality results are unestablished (temperature puzzle Admitted and misformulated over abstract Parameters — the negated-universal form is refutable when rise' is instantiated empty, so it must be restated as a concrete-model construction; seek ambiguity vacuous). These are effort/formulation gaps ('evidence about us'), not theory resistance, so slight_modification is the supported prediction pending an atlas-grade rebuild with a concrete model and zero-axiom discipline.

artifact_classes.description: IL absorbed by shallow HOAS embedding (no object syntax, no substitution theory — quantifying-in via assignment functions); analysis trees are not category-indexed, so the total mutual Fixpoint requires vacuous True fallbacks for ill-typed or unimplemented constructors (E_S6/E_S9 silently denote True) — Coq lacks the partial, category-sorted term algebra PTQ's syntax presupposes

IL type t identified with Prop; quantifiers range over the FULL Coq function space Index->Entity (a standard-model commitment PTQ's general models do not force); the_den uses Leibniz equality on concepts without functional extensionality

abstract Parameters for Entity/World/Time and the whole lexicon make the semantics non-computational by design ('we reason in Prop, we don't compute') and preclude the countermodel the temperature puzzle needs inside the file

notes: Record produced by the batch audit sweep of 2026-09-05; pre-atlas pilot file predating the zero-axiom discipline (38 signature Parameters + 11 propositional Axioms, the latter mostly Montague's own p. 28 meaning postulates cited in comments).
